title: Introduction to Neural Networks
description: What a neural network actually computes, before any deep learning framework.
learningOutcomes: Explain a neuron, layer, and activation function
Explain forward pass and backpropagation conceptually
Train a tiny network with scikit-learn's MLP

lessons.title: The Neuron and the Layer
lessons.description: A neural network as stacked weighted sums and nonlinearities.
learningObjectives: Explain why nonlinear activations are necessary
Stack neurons into a layer mentally

lessons.title: The Forward Pass
lessons.description: How input becomes output through a network.
learningObjectives: Trace a forward pass through a small network by hand
Connect the forward pass to a prediction

lessons.title: Backpropagation, Intuitively
lessons.description: How a network learns from its mistakes, without the full derivation.
learningObjectives: Explain gradient descent's role in training
Explain backpropagation as the chain rule applied to layers

lessons.title: Training a First Network
lessons.description: Fit a small MLP classifier and watch it learn.
learningObjectives: Diagnose an undertrained vs. overfit network
